character_sheet: A cassowary: a body angled up with a tail behind, a neck base and a long neck bent up and back over it, a head with a beak and a casque crest on top, a wattle ('gobbler') under the throat, and two legs with feet (ModelCassowary.java:39-117; 12 parts on a 64x32 sheet). It is a skittish bird: 10 HP, speed 0.25, an unused 8-damage attribute (Cassowary.java:55-60) - no goal strikes. It floats (:45), breeds on crystal apples (:46, :93-96), runs from monsters AND players (:47-48), panics when hurt (:49), watches other mobs (:50) and wanders (:51); it spawns by day (:104-109) and a chick is drawn at half size (CassowaryRenderer.java:30-31). Read it as a nervous flightless bird: a quick two-legged stride with the neck and wattle bobbing at twice the step, frozen still when it stops.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig, x0.5 as a chick (CassowaryRenderer.java:20, 30-31) on a 64x32 sheet (ModelCassowary.java:117); the hitbox is 0.5 x 1.2 (ModEntities.java:347-348); shadow 0.5 (CassowaryRenderer.java:23).

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) x the walking speed at 1.3 x 0.55 - still below the 0.1 threshold, no rest offsets
groups.plain: the two legs stride in opposition, each foot swinging with its leg
groups.math: a = limbSwingAmount > 0.1 ? cos(ageInTicks * 1.3 * 0.55) * pi * 0.15 * limbSwingAmount : 0; leg1.xRot = foot2.xRot = a; leg2.xRot = foot1.xRot = -a
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 0.55 (wingspeed, ModelCassowary.java:24): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.715 = 8.8 ticks

groups.name: neck_bob
groups.axis: x (the neck and wattle); the crest, beak and head slide with the neck's end
groups.amplitude: neck: -2.827 rad rest, then pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg) x the walking speed at 2.6 x 0.55 (twice the gait rate); the wattle the same around 0; the crest, beak and head are placed 7 units along the neck's pitch, so they ride its bob as a position; nothing below the 0.1 threshold
groups.plain: the neck and the wattle bob twice per stride and the head, beak and crest ride up and down on the end of the neck; still when standing
groups.math: b = limbSwingAmount > 0.1 ? cos(ageInTicks * 2.6 * 0.55) * pi * 0.1 * limbSwingAmount : 0; neck.xRot = -2.827 + b; gobbler.xRot = b; crest.z = beak.z = head.z = neck.z + sin(neck.xRot) * 7; crest.y = beak.y = head.y = neck.y + cos(neck.xRot) * 7
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 2.6 x 0.55: the natural period is 2 pi / 1.43 = 4.4 ticks - twice the gait rate; the walking branch scales it by speed though it is not the gait group

behaviour: Everything moves only above a walking speed of 0.1 (ModelCassowary.java:124-130); standing, the bird is frozen - no breath, no head turn (netHeadYaw unused, so the LookAtPlayerGoal at Cassowary.java:50 turns nothing).

The gait (:125, :131-134): the cosine of the age x 1.3 x 0.55 (wingspeed, :24), x pi x 0.15, x the walking speed swings the left leg and foot forward and the right leg and foot back - 27 degrees at full stride every 8.8 ticks (the code pairs leg1 with foot2 and leg2 with foot1: they share pivots, so each pair is one leg).

The neck bobs at twice the stride rate (:126, :135-136): -2.827 rad plus the cosine of the age x 2.6 x 0.55, x pi x 0.1, x the walking speed - 18 degrees every 4.4 ticks - and the wattle takes the same angle around 0.

The head, beak and crest have no rotation of their own: the code places all three 7 units along the neck's pitch (:137-142), so they ride the bob as a position - an FK step written by hand on flat bones (when the rig lands, key their positions with the neck or parent them to it).
The body, tail and neck base never move; there is no attacking flag and no strike.

clips.note: ruled 2026-09-06, Q3 (a): the vanilla death flip stays; a creature whose JSON ships a `death` clip gets the clip-replaces-flip mode, designed when the first such clip arrives (the Queen's own death clip the precedent) - a `death` delivered here plays under the flip until then

wishlist: in `idle`: the code freezes the bird when it stops (ModelCassowary.java:127-130) - give it a head cock and a wattle twitch so it reads alive; it runs from players (Cassowary.java:48), so wariness fits
in `walk`: a bird's stride - a knee that lags the hip (leg and foot swing as one, ModelCassowary.java:131-134) and a forward lunge of the neck on each step instead of the up-and-down bob

the head, beak and crest ride the neck's end as code-placed positions (ModelCassowary.java:137-142): author the neck as a rotation and flag to the owner that the seam must parent the three head parts to the neck or key their positions when the rig lands
in `hurt` / before the panic (Cassowary.java:49): a startled leap with the tail flaring
formulas: `ModelCassowary.setupAnim` (ModelCassowary.java:121-143; orig ModelCassowary.java:113-126 in `render` (func_78088_a, :106-139; func_78087_a at :147-149 is a bare super call), wingspeed 0.55 from `new ModelCassowary(0.55f)` in orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:469): while the walking speed is above a tenth the leg swing is the cosine of the age in ticks times 1.3 times 0.55, times pi, times 0.15, times the walking speed and the neck bob the cosine of the age times 2.6 times 0.55, times pi, times 0.1, times the walking speed; at or below it both are 0; leg1 and foot2 pitch by the leg swing, leg2 and foot1 by its negative, the neck by -2.827 plus the bob and the gobbler by the bob; the crest, beak and head are placed from the neck's bind pivot 7 units along the neck's pitch - their z the neck's z plus 7 times the sine of the neck's pitch, their y the neck's y plus 7 times its cosine (Mth.sin and Mth.cos, the float table). The walk position, the head angles and the entity's state play no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (CassowaryGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations).
